fields.tier: local, regional or realm on the shared ladder
fields.clock_seeds: progress clocks the faction can run (dungeon/factions.py); the engine copy is world/data/factions/havenbrooke.json
fields.eras: campaign eras the faction exists in; missing means all

factions.name: The Department of Esoteric Development
factions.summary: The federal body that regulates magic, species activities and interspecies relations, founded in 1863. Five divisions: Field Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Licensing and Certification, Research, and Community Affairs. It opened Havenbrooke in 1867 and still reviews every MTO syllabus.
goals: Keep the Esoteric Development Code enforced
Place Havenbrooke graduates in its field offices
Keep the classified supplements classified

factions.name: The Federal Esoteric Court
factions.summary: Seven judges who settle conflicts between federal law and the internal law of the fae courts, the covens and the old vampire families. It meets four times a year in closed session.
goals: Keep the parallel legal systems from colliding

factions.name: Havenbrooke University
factions.summary: A federal integration college turned autonomous university: five teaching platforms, about 5,000 students, a 20 percent acceptance rate and a charter that has loosened since 1954. Missed or failed work costs standing here, and scholarships ride on grades.
goals: Keep its students alive, enrolled and out of the papers
Keep the DED and the Crane money happy
Graduate integration, not just degrees

factions.name: City of Haven
factions.summary: The city government and Haven PD: 42 officers, three of them esoteric liaisons, and a long habit of calling the university before anyone else.
goals: Keep town and gown from fighting
Keep the tourists coming

factions.name: The Council of Bloodlines
factions.summary: Twelve seats for the old vampire families of North America, each with a territory. Lucian Crane holds New England. Born vampires run it; turned ones are tolerated.
goals: Keep territorial agreements
Keep the born above the turned
Keep vampire business internal

factions.name: The Crane family
factions.summary: The vampire family that has held Crane Hill above Haven since 1819, founded Phi Sigma Nox in 1874 and funds two university scholarships a year. The university answers their calls. Some of their collection is not legal.
goals: Stay untouchable
Keep the collection
Keep Vivienne on the diplomatic track

factions.name: The National Coven Registry
factions.summary: Founded in Salem in 1912. It registers covens and lineages, and arbitrates between them before the DED has to.
goals: Keep witchcraft respected and a little misunderstood
Keep the lineages registered

factions.name: The Corwin lineage
factions.summary: A third-generation Boston witch family with three senators, a federal judge and Genevieve Corwin's private ritual consultancy behind it. It expected Kim at Salem Academy.
goals: Bring Kim back on track
Put her in the ritual-leadership suite on the family's terms
methods: layovers that exist on no itinerary

factions.name: The Providence coven
factions.summary: A senior coven that recruits Havenbrooke's best witches by invitation. Oriane Dupré is one of its seniors.
goals: Recruit the best of each class

factions.name: The Lycan Assembly
factions.summary: Founded in 1952 to speak for born and bitten lycans nationally. Born packs dominate it; bitten lycans grumble.
goals: Keep the bite legal and regulated
Stop underground conversions

factions.name: The Fae Heritage Council
factions.summary: The American face of the fae courts, for dealing with human law.
goals: Protect fae custom inside US law

factions.name: The Eastern Seelie court
factions.summary: The Seelie court of the eastern seaboard and its archives, where betrothals, anchor bonds and inheritances are recorded. One of its clerks owes Rina a favor.
goals: Keep the records true
Keep alliances binding

factions.name: House Aelhwynn
factions.summary: Rina's family, a mid-tier fae house that runs on betrothals, alliances and aesthetic compliance. It promised her to a sylph diplomat when she was a child.
goals: See Rina married to Callum Ashveil
Keep the grove and its alliance

factions.name: The Vhen-Morrath line
factions.summary: An old incubus and succubus family, "the line of the first hearth". Demon families have no national body, so a line is its own law. Jason, Christine and Aurelio Marchant are all of it.
goals: Keep its children in the diplomatic pipeline
Keep its business in the family

factions.name: Alpha Gamma
factions.summary: The lycan-heavy supernatural fraternity, with species-diversity rules, full-moon ceremonies in the basement and a bonded-brothers ritual in Ironroot Woods. It co-hosts the Harvest Howl.
goals: A chosen family for brothers who need one
Careers in defence agencies

factions.name: Phi Sigma Nox
factions.summary: The oldest supernatural fraternity, chartered in 1874 with two Cranes on its council. Vampire-heavy, tailored, patient, with four galas a year and a cellar library of occult texts.
goals: Heritage over recruitment
Long-planned influence

factions.name: Sigma Theta Hex
factions.summary: The witch sorority: thirty to forty sisters, line-sister pairings, a private ritual tongue, custody of Vespers Hall's largest spell ring and an alumnae network in business, politics and academia.
goals: Magical excellence
Influence after graduation
Mastery of the campus ley lines

factions.name: Delta Nu Iris
factions.summary: The fae sorority, chartered 1921, in a Craftsman on Birch Street with a back garden of anchor-ground and plants that are illegal in New York State. An informal back channel to the courts.
goals: Preserve fae practice
Help sisters with betrothals and anchors

factions.name: Omicron Phi Ember (the Ember Circle)
factions.summary: The co-ed society for demonkin and others who must feed, founded in 1952. Its rush includes a formal hunger assessment, it meets Tuesday nights in Bellweather and it keeps no house.
goals: Ethical feeding
Mutual support

factions.name: Kappa Rho Sigma
factions.summary: The mundane-human men's fraternity, chartered 1901, which excludes witches and lives inside Thornewall's suppression field on purpose. Unapologetically careerist.
goals: Networks strong enough for mundane graduates to compete

factions.name: Delta Omicron Theta
factions.summary: The co-ed mundane-human house on Birch Street, founded 1976: a zine, a podcast, a 48-hour film project and better parties than the gated houses.
goals: The full college experience for mundane students

factions.name: Phi Alpha Mu
factions.summary: The integration house, chartered in 1964, open across species and practice, with rotating community dinners and the Integration Ambassadors behind it.
goals: Integration as a skill that can be taught

factions.name: Kindling
factions.summary: Jason's support group for students learning to live with their appetites, named by Whitestone: "a fire that is built, not caught". It meets on the Old Observatory rooftop. It does not exist yet at the start of sophomore year.
goals: Somewhere to say the worst thing out loud
A DED pilot

factions.name: The Integration Society
factions.summary: A loose monthly meet-up on the Observatory roof for students managing appetite, shift or cycles, run by Adrien Halvers.
goals: Keep the format informal

factions.name: Hexenkreis
factions.summary: The advanced witch practice society, Wednesday evenings in Vespers Hall's second chamber.
goals: Collaborative castings no witch can manage alone

factions.name: The Student Enchanters' Guild
factions.summary: Charm and enchantment students, in a workshop inside the Verdant Grove; Piper is vice-chair.
goals: The annual charm exhibit

factions.name: The Havenbrooke Oracle
factions.summary: The weekly student paper, mundane-majority by tradition, in a basement under Thornewall. Kwame Adjei edits it.
goals: Print what costs someone something

factions.name: The Crestfall Crows
factions.summary: Havenbrooke athletics in the fifteen-school NSAC: lycan rugby (nine titles in twelve years), fae aerial combat, track, mixed fencing and club swimming. Black and umber.
goals: Win the NSAC
